applied.location: §3 identity/notification bars + §6 Notifications, end to end
applied.resolution: Verified in current draft: §3 now scopes the round-trip claim ('the round-trip exists on Linux in exactly one place: halinuxcompanion, the native-API-class exception, implements it over mobile_app with a local aiohttp HTTP server... a 90-star Python project whose roadmap's other item is "Move sensors to MQTT"') and §6 reads 'no MQTT-transport implementation anywhere (the one Linux round-trip, halinuxcompanion's, rides the native API with a local HTTP server — the class whose own sensor-stranding problem §3 documents)'. False-absence claim fully corrected in both locations; corrected form is stronger for the thesis.

Verified: §4.A now reads 'the launcher mutual-exclusion select is one custom module away — lnxlink's bash surface cannot emit a select at all... but its custom-module surface demonstrably can (the Lutris Game Launcher dropdown ships that way)' and §4.B carries the bash-surface refutation plus the declarative-generation and state-round-trip counter.

Verified: 'Second, the adopter's fork that dissolves the expressibility objection over time: contribute the select support and a NixOS service module upstream... The evidence on record prices that path: it runs through a maintainer whose changelog shows zero select/state-sync occurrences across 3,909 commits and whose two open notification feature requests have sat unassigned since December 2025... the same maintenance arithmetic the objection itself raises, with less control.'

Verified: heading now 'Mesh/exit-node health (europa, fleet visibility)'; body reads 'the unverified backend maps onto europa, the host where the mesh hub (headscale) runs, with callisto's and the kiosks' agents reporting peer/exit-node state as tailnet members' — consistent with §1.

Verified: causation rewritten — 'an individual hit a wall packaging it in October 2025 and no one has upstreamed a service module in the year since an unmerged draft appeared in August 2024 — and its Python dependency surface... is the ongoing per-release maintenance cost for whoever owns that packaging'. No setuptools-causation claim remains.

Verified: lead now reads 'this run's fleet audit on 2 September 2026 found all four TCxWave kiosks reading UNAVAILABLE... the complaint, dated, not a standing state' and §1 'The run's live fleet audit on 2 September 2026 found the four kiosks' entities reading unavailable on callisto's HA — the complaint observed live and dated, not recalled'. The supervisor-spec interim citation sits only on the two-bugs diagnosis.

Verified: 'the hook must be a fast hand-off — write the SMARTD_* event to the agent's channel and exit immediately (a detached spawn or socket write), never an inline MQTT publish that would stall smartd's monitoring loop'.
Verified: 'the unified identity stops not-working the moment the ConnAck supervisor lands, which is the Phase 1 estimate of one to two weeks, not a research programme' — aligned with §8 Phase 1.
Verified: 'an MQTT v5 requirement (already satisfied by callisto's version-current mosquitto, so a non-cost on this fleet)'.

Verified: 'default builds need CMake, a C compiler, and system OpenSSL, a foreign dependency chain in every host closure (the interim's one open question, whether nixpkgs' paho-c packaging is already clean, is unverified; the application-owned re-subscription point alone decides the client question)'.

Verified: 'the alternatives table's remaining names, System Bridge (a WebSocket-API companion) and IoTuring (a thinner MQTT transport), are covered by the class arguments — System Bridge joins the native-API class and inherits exactly the halinuxcompanion concession... IoTuring is MQTT-transport with a far thinner surface than lnxlink's ~50 modules'.

Verified: 'Crash stays dead' row in §1 table ('NixOS user services default Restart=no... the third leg of "never reliable"'), §2.D carries 'the crash path is worse... nothing restarts the process today', and the supervisor paragraph adds 'Restart=on-failure plus WatchdogSec via sd_notify — ESPHome's reboot_timeout analogue, rebooting the agent after 15 minutes without a healthy loop — so a panic costs one restart, not the host's telemetry until the next boot'.

Verified: decommission design expanded — ghost-resurrection rationale (retained configs survive HA restarts, no v3.1.1 message expiry, ESPHome clean-mqtt parallel), descriptor-derived topic list ('so the two can never drift'), state/availability-first configs-last Homie ordering, opportunistic last-discovery.json diff clearing removed topics on next start.

Verified: re-anchored to [[jupiteros-notification-ground-truth]] (step-13 gap-fill note) with audited grep named (mako/dunst/swaync/fnott/notify-send across modules/ and hosts/*/), VFD last-mile attributed to the same ground-truth note, risk restated as conditional (dead code today, stands for a future desktop host class, Environment block conditional likewise), and Phase 2 exit criterion rescope to the busctl owner check before any delivery test.

Verified: both hand-off designs present (JSON line into /var/lib/ha-linux-agent/smartd/ spool vs direct MQTT publish as low-privilege client) plus NixOS surface (smartd_warning.d entry / jupiter.storage.smartMonitoring.hook option) and europa's all-SATA inventory scoping the capability rejection a fortiori.

Verified: DynamicUser= elimination on upstream D-Bus authority (cannot allocate a D-Bus service name, implies ProtectSystem=strict blocking sysfs/probe surface) and polkit mechanism (grants key on subject.user == 'io', satisfied unchanged by User=io, zero new grants).

Verified: Event-enum enumeration ('0.24.0's Event enum has exactly two variants — Incoming and Outgoing, no Reconnect... making the raw ConnAck match not a workaround but the mandatory design') and unimplemented!()-reachability note ('its single unimplemented!() sits on request variants (PubComp/SubAck/UnsubAck/PingResp) the public client never sends — unreachable from agent code').

Verified: 'the more obvious observability API, BecomeMonitor (busctl --system monitor), was tried live and polkit-denied for io, so the design commits to match-rule subscription (zbus receive_signal / MessageStream with a match rule) specifically, never BecomeMonitor'.

Verified: ZEVENT_-prefixed environment variables, filename-prefix registration, root-owned no-group-write zedlets, and zfs-zed.service already wanted by zfs.target (no new unit — only zed.rc plus one custom zedlet).

Verified: 'the harness needs zero new flake ingredients — mosquitto already ships in the devShell, pkgs.dbus already rides commonArgs' buildInputs, and crane's derivation attributes pass straight through... with no preCheck hook' plus the regression-guard house style (See-commit-e28ca83 pattern).

Verified: mesh paragraph states backend-headscale's current mechanism is the tailscale status --json shell-out (verification and version-tolerance of an existing channel, on europa the mesh hub); reboot paragraph replaced the asserted hazard with the idempotency-audit next step calibrating the clean-session stakes.

Verified: 'kiosks run the hardware backend's backlight disabled, so the deployed brightness entity is the launcher's screen-power light profile (backlight = "")... the udev rule must therefore cover the *launcher* backend's write path, which is the consumer the kiosks actually use'.

Verified: covered by the D1 patch — halinuxcompanion's native-API round-trip, 90-star scale, and Move-sensors-to-MQTT roadmap concession now sit exactly where the round-trip claim is made, with the closer 'the strongest possible evidence for how small the MQTT-only sacrifice is'.

Verified: §5.C summed sentence now names the designation leg ('tailscale set --operator=io... unprivileged operation of tailscaled is a designation, not a default... with --socket=<path> for NixOS's socket location') and §6 carries the operational surface (tailscale wait / tailscale-online.target readiness gate, BackendState running-indicator, frozen-by-policy --json contract as schema check).

Verified: audited-absence statement (search of modules/ and hosts/*/ for ups, nut, apc returns zero matches) plus NUT-shaped design for the day one is attached (server-required, port 3493, 60-second polling, instcmds gated on upsd.users, DNS-name resolution, upsc/upscmd enumeration), with the generation/boot sensor folded in.

Verified: 'first-class notify entity' phrasing adopted; notify.py source as primary-source leg of the confirmation chain; named ceiling that legacy notify-service consumers (alert integration) cannot target entity notifiers, with notify.send_message + entity_id as the entity-ecosystem route.

Verified: niri security model inserted ('IPC-socket access can "Spawn a Wayland client — which in turn can record the screen, emulate input, read the clipboard, spoof password dialogs via layer-shell"... a privileged capability in practice, not a free convenience') plus connect_to()/NIRI_SOCKET as the cleaner reach.

Verified: all four cluster claims present — per-drive optional self-test (Intel 600p oacs bit), go-hass-agent attributes-vs-entities precedent, wear/vendor-EOL as distinct sensors (~1% rated TBW), and the caveat framing ('Three caveats the hook design carries'). Control-node targeting (/dev/nvme0) not added to §5.C; subsumed by europa's all-SATA scoping which makes NVMe targeting moot on this fleet.

Verified: [[github-mic92sops-nix-atomic-secret-provisioning-for-nixos-based-on-sops-github]] citation added plus the home-manager contrast clause ($XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/secrets.d, ordering requirements, 'the simpler of the two documented shapes').

Verified: both empirical precedents inserted — merged PR #283878 ('Serving HTTP on 127.0.0.1 port 8000' build log) and the same author's Discourse cross-boundary failure ('different loopback interfaces in different namespaces') as the reason the harness spawns mosquitto inside the test.

Verified: 'a standing publish/subscribe round-trip self-probe (the blackbox-exporter pattern, where message loss is a published-minus-received counter delta and a hang is started-minus-completed) turns deafness from an incident into an alarm, implementable inside the agent or as an HA automation with no extra exporter'.

Verified: dedicated paragraph ('The backends the fleet never runs') delivers backend-kde hard-fail (Connection::session().await? at backend-kde/src/lib.rs:41), zero fleet consumers (no host runs Plasma), the boundary condition for hosting a desktop class, backend-gamescope's callisto-arcade-only consumer, and backend-lutris's unexercised launch-only buttons with the unverified-live flags.

Verified: kiosk row now carries 'screen-power profile fused to tcxwave-screen-power.service (touch-wake, polkit-gated for io per tcxwave-touch-wake.nix:287), session mutual-exclusion select, customer-display switch' — the surfaces Phase 2 must preserve.
Verified: ganymede-successor named as the first named future consumer of the server/minimal role switch (always-on headless host planned for mosquitto, the HA VM, and n8n, no host configuration yet).
Verified: 'The workspace is twelve crates, eleven commits, 43 files, audited at commit 8369f44 in September 2026'.

This pass removed the remaining fourth recitation: §4.D's 'fix the lifecycle, keep the sensor surface deliberately minimal per host class, spend features only where jupiterOS consumes them' (exec preamble retains the canonical statement). Verified no load-bearing mechanism lost.

applied.location: Exec preamble final sentences + Opinionated Synthesis final paragraph
applied.resolution: Two cuts: (1) exec preamble's 'Adoption is the wrong move — the fleet's deciding features are exactly what no incumbent can express' condensed to one clause ('adoption is answered at full strength in §4, where it fails on packaging and expressibility' — the verbatim 'deciding features are exactly what' phrase now appears only in §8's forward-looking strategic point); (2) synthesis close de-duplicated against §8: dropped the third listing of the flip conditions (replaced with a pointer) and the verbatim 'unit health, storage health, and session state / supervised lifecycle' enumeration, ending instead on the launcher-select payoff. 'Privilege/feature same document' phrasing also de-duplicated (now stated in §6 preamble only).
